title: Create src/lib/feature/clarifier.ts — AI-powered question generation
description: Create a module that reads the existing PRD and feature description, sends them to the AI backend, and returns 3-5 targeted clarifying questions about the feature. Falls back to seeded questions if AI is unavailable.
acceptanceCriteria: Questions are relevant to the feature description
Falls back to seed questions if AI backend fails
Seed questions cover scope, UI needs, API changes, dependencies, and edge cases

steps.details: Create the file. Import AgentBackend from backends/types.ts. Define seed questions: const SEED_QUESTIONS = ['What problem does this feature solve?', 'Who is the primary user of this feature?', 'Are there UI components needed, or is this backend-only?', 'Does this depend on any existing tasks or features?', 'Any known edge cases or constraints?']

export async function generateQuestions(prdContent: string, featureDescription: string, backend: AgentBackend): Promise<string[]> { // Build a prompt asking the AI to generate 3-5 clarifying questions // Spawn the backend, collect output, parse questions from response // If parsing fails, return SEED_QUESTIONS.slice(0, 5) }

steps.description: Parse AI response and extract questions
steps.details: Collect all output from the AI backend process. Extract JSON array from the response (handle markdown code fences). Parse and validate it's an array of strings. If validation fails, fall back to seed questions.

technicalNotes: The AI may wrap JSON in markdown code fences (```json ... ```) — strip these before parsing
Validate the response is an array of 3-5 strings — reject and fall back if it doesn't match
